ApiKeyScope.description: `x:write` implies `x:read`; `admin` implies every workspace scope. `artifacts:pin` (pin and unpin artifacts; Gradiated Cloud's publishing calls it) is implied by `admin` only. `deployments:write`, `feedback:write` and `env:serve` are Gradiated Cloud scopes: grad-server accepts them on a key but none of its endpoints checks them.

name.description: Artifact name, usually the run name.

version.description: Version, `YYYY-MM-DD-N`: the release date and its sequence that day.

run_id.description: The run that trained it; null for uploads and imports.

checkpoint_id.description: The checkpoint it was promoted from; null when it is a run's final artifact or was uploaded or imported.

base_model.description: The base model the weights apply to.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bundle; downloads verify it.

manifest.description: The bundle's manifest.json: format, base model, adapter and training settings.

pins.description: Holders keeping it (a published model version, say), oldest first. A pinned artifact can't be deleted.

url.description: A presigned GET of the bundle (.grad.tar.gz) straight from storage; no Authorization header. Verify its SHA-256.

ArtifactFormat.description: Artifact format when this checkpoint is exportable (promotable); null for training state only.

revision.description: HF imports: the requested revision, then the pinned commit once imported.

artifact_id.description: The artifact (name@version) once the import completed.

error.description: Why it failed. Validation failures name the file and the problem (`adapter_config.json: ...`).

error_code.description: invalid_artifact (the files don't match the format spec or the base model), source_unavailable, or null.

upload_id.description: A tar (optionally gzip) of the artifact's files, uploaded with POST /v1/uploads.

revision.description: Branch, tag or commit (default main). The import pins the commit it resolves.

secret.description: Name of a workspace secret holding a Hugging Face token, for gated or private repos.

source.description: run: trained by a grad run; upload: files uploaded with `grad artifacts upload`; import: pulled from the Hugging Face Hub with `grad artifacts import`.

run_id.description: source=run: the run that trained it.

uploader.description: source=upload: the API key (principal) that uploaded it.

uri.description: source=import: `hf://owner/name@<40-hex commit>`, the pinned revision it was imported from.

seq.description: Position in the run's event sequence (the SSE event id; pass it as Last-Event-ID or `cursor` to resume). `completed` repeats the last stored seq.

event.description: started: a worker claimed attempt N (resume_step: the checkpoint it resumes from). interrupted: attempt N ended without a result at `step` (resume_step: where the next attempt resumes). gave_up: no attempts left; the run failed.

resume_step.description: Checkpoint step to resume from; null starts from scratch.

BaseArtifact.description: Continued training: the artifact whose adapter the run starts from (recipe.model was an artifact reference).

step.description: Optimizer step it was saved at.

eval_score.description: Held-out score at this step; null when it wasn't evaluated.

best.description: True for the checkpoint `select="best"` picks; it never expires.

final.description: True for the run's last checkpoint; it never expires.

expires_at.description: When it expires (after `checkpoint_ttl_days`, 30 by default); null for checkpoints that never expire, such as the best and final.

score.description: The checkpoint's overall rubric score (null unless completed).

seq.description: Position in the run's event sequence (the SSE event id; pass it as Last-Event-ID or `cursor` to resume). `completed` repeats the last stored seq.
Position in the run's event sequence (the SSE event id; pass it as Last-Event-ID or `cursor` to resume). `completed` repeats the last stored seq.

base_model.description: The catalog base model (GET /v1/base-models) the files were trained on.

name.description: The artifact name (name@YYYY-MM-DD-n). Required for uploads; HF imports default to the repo's name.

schedule.description: Five-field cron in UTC (`*/15 * * * *`); minute resolution, so it fires at most once a minute (a seconds field is rejected). Leave it out to sync only on request.

sample_rate.description: The share of traces to sync, chosen by a hash of the trace id: re-syncs keep the same sample, and a trace's feedback follows it. Default 1.

max_records_per_sync.description: At most this many new traces per sync; the rest are not synced (the sync's drop reasons count them). Feedback on traces already synced always lands. Null: no cap.

max_records_per_day.description: At most this many new traces per UTC day; the rest are not synced (the sync's drop reasons count them). Feedback on traces already synced always lands. Null: no cap.

version_interval.description: Seconds between the dataset versions scheduled syncs commit (default 900). A scheduled sync may fetch every minute; its parts wait, staged, until the interval has passed or enough records are waiting, so a busy source doesn't add a version a minute. 0: every sync commits. Manual and full syncs always commit.

name.description: Dataset name, unique in the workspace.

version.description: Current version. Every push, import, score or sync that changes records adds one; runs and evals pin a version.

record_count.description: Records in the current version after merging: score updates fold into their records, and a full source sync restarts the count. A record pushed again with an id it already has counts again.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata you set at creation.

scores.description: Conditions on stored scores, `{name: "<op><number>"}` with op one of >=, <=, >, <, ==, != (a bare number means ==). A record without the score does not match.

created_after.description: Records whose `timestamp` is at or after this time (a timestamp with offset, or a UTC date `YYYY-MM-DD`).

created_before.description: Records whose `timestamp` is before this time.

ids.description: Keep only these record ids (what the SDKs send for a filter function they ran locally).

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page (every list endpoint).

EvalMode.description: `eval` generates outputs from `models`; `score` (`dataset.score()`) grades each record's own output (model `record`) and writes the scores to the dataset's next version.

metric_name.description: Selection metric: eval_loss (sft, router, decision, off-policy distill, pointwise-only reward), preference_accuracy (dpo, reward), eval_kl (cartridge, on-policy distill), recall_at_10 (embedding).

metric_mode.description: Direction of metric_name: min (lower is better: eval_loss, eval_kl) or max (higher is better: preference_accuracy, recall_at_10). best_step and the pinned best checkpoint follow it.

eval_loss.description: Written by: sft, dpo, router, decision, distill, reward.

eval_examples.description: Written by: sft, router, decision, distill.

preference_accuracy.description: Share of held-out pairs whose chosen answer outscores the rejected one. Written by: dpo, reward.

pointwise_brier.description: Mean squared error of sigmoid(reward) against the held-out scores. Written by: reward (pointwise).

base_kl.description: Held-out KL of the untrained student to the teacher. Written by: distill (on-policy).

heads.description: Written by: decision (one entry per question).

baseline.description: Retrieval metrics of the untrained base encoder. Written by: embedding.

runtime.description: Code scorers always run in the SDK process (`local`); the eval waits in `awaiting_scores` until the SDK posts their scores.

models.description: The models evaluated: catalog ids, artifacts (`name@version`) or models the inference endpoint serves.

baseline.description: The model the summary compares the others with (`vs_baseline`); null for none.

samples.description: Answers generated per task and model.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature of the model calls.

max_tokens.description: The most tokens each answer may have.

pass_threshold.description: Score at or above which a task passes.

judge_models.description: The judge models the rubric calls.

local_scorers.description: Code scorers that run in the SDK process; the eval waits in `awaiting_scores` until they post their scores.

total_cost_usd.description: Cost of the model and judge calls so far, in USD.

scored_dataset_version.description: Scoring jobs: the dataset version holding the new scores (the source version when every record was already scored); null until completed.

error.description: Why the eval failed; null otherwise.

waiting_reason.description: While running: the eval's model calls are waiting for capacity (a serving pool at zero that has not woken yet), for a rate limit (a full eval lane), or for an inference endpoint that is down. The worker keeps its lease and retries; this is not counted as a failed attempt. null otherwise.

completed_at.description: When the eval reached a final status; null until then.

version.description: Source version to filter (default: the current version).

name.description: Name of the view. Default: `<dataset>-f-<hash of source, version and filter>`, so the same filter returns the same view.

GpuInfo.description: starting: the claiming worker's GPU (null without one, e.g. the reference backend). Never the worker id or host.

IdempotencyKey.description: Up to 255 visible ASCII characters (SDKs send a UUIDv4 and reuse it across retries). A create retried with the same key and body returns what the first request created, with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different body is rejected with 422 `idempotency_key_reused`. The key is stored on the created resource, in the same transaction.

imported_count.description: Records this import added to the dataset (score updates for existing records add none).

drop_reasons.description: Why rows were dropped, one line per row (`line 12: invalid JSON`), capped at 100 entries.

secret.description: Name of a workspace secret holding a Hugging Face token, for gated or private datasets. The worker receives the token at claim time.

benchmark.description: A built-in benchmark, imported from Hugging Face at a pinned revision with fixed prompts; evals on the dataset default to its answer check.

limit.description: Import the first N problems (the same ones every time).

InterruptionReason.description: Why an attempt ended without a result: lease_lost (the worker was lost: it stopped heartbeating after a crash, kill or network failure), compute_reclaimed (the GPU was reclaimed; the worker saved a checkpoint when it had time and handed the run back), worker_error (the worker hit an unexpected error and handed the run back), oom (CUDA out of memory).

seq.description: Position in the run's event sequence (the SSE event id; pass it as Last-Event-ID or `cursor` to resume). `completed` repeats the last stored seq.

secret.description: Workspace secret holding the W&B API key.

run_name.description: Tracker run name (default: the grad run name).

secret.description: Workspace secret holding a bearer token for the tracking server, if it needs one.

run_name.description: Tracker run name (default: the grad run name).

seq.description: Position in the run's event sequence (the SSE event id; pass it as Last-Event-ID or `cursor` to resume). `completed` repeats the last stored seq.

eval_metrics.description: Held-out metrics of an eval step by name (including the recipe's selection metric, eval_report.metric_name); absent on steps without an eval.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page (every list endpoint).

tail_cursor.description: Cursor after the newest point returned so far; pass it back as `cursor` to poll for points written later (tailing a running run).

grad_clip.description: Max global gradient norm; 0 disables clipping.

seq.description: Position in the run's event sequence (the SSE event id; pass it as Last-Event-ID or `cursor` to resume). `completed` repeats the last stored seq.

step.description: Training step when the phase began (0 before training; the resume step on a resumed attempt).

workers_online.description: queued and waiting_for_compute: workers of this job kind holding a lease (all busy; an idle worker would have claimed the run).

autoscaling.description: queued and waiting_for_compute: true when workers scale from zero (KEDA), so one is starting rather than missing.

queue_position.description: queued and waiting_for_compute: about how many runs start before this one when the phase began (fair share across workspaces). Run.queue_position is the live value.

message.description: queued and waiting_for_compute: why the run waits, ready to show ("Queued behind 3 runs", "Queued: workspace concurrency limit (8 running)", "Waiting for a GPU with ≥46 GB; online workers have 24 GB"). Null when it is next in line.

PlanCostBreakdown.description: estimated_cost_usd split by what bills it; the parts sum to it (to rounding).

train_usd.description: The base model's tokens on every training step: each record (or both sides of a preference pair) once per epoch, at price_per_million_tokens. Held-out evaluation during training is not billed.

teacher_usd.description: The teacher's tokens (on-policy distill), at its price.

eval_usd.description: Evals the run starts, billed as evals: the labeling eval before training and recipe.evals on every checkpoint.

models.description: The models to evaluate: catalog ids, artifacts (`name@version`) or models your inference endpoint serves.

baseline.description: One of `models`; the summary reports every other model's difference from it.

dataset.description: The dataset whose records are the tasks.

dataset_version.description: The version to evaluate. Default: the current one, pinned when the eval is created.

rubric.description: Default: the dataset's own rubric (a benchmark's answer check), else a non_empty validator.

samples.description: Answers per task and model; 3 or more for decisions you will act on.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature of the model calls.

max_tokens.description: The most tokens each answer may have.

pass_threshold.description: Defaults to 1.0 when every rubric item is binary (regex/validator) and 0.5 otherwise.

dataset.description: Dataset to train on. The run pins its current version.

name.description: Run name; the artifact it produces is released as `name@version`.

max_cost_usd.description: Hard spend cap in USD. The run stops with `stopped_budget` and keeps its checkpoint when it reaches the cap, and is never billed past it. Default: no cap.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Everything the run is expected to bill: training (and teacher) tokens, plus the evals it starts (labeling, recipe.evals). See cost_breakdown.

estimated_duration_s.description: Wall-clock estimate in seconds on one H100 80 GB: model load and export, training at the measured tokens/s for this base and recipe, evaluations and checkpoints. Excludes queueing and any labeling eval.

min_gpu_memory_gb.description: GPU memory (GB) this run needs: the base's min_gpu_memory_gb plus a teacher loaded beside it. Null when the base's requirement is unknown.

labeling.description: The labeling eval that runs before training (billed as an eval, included in estimated_cost_usd): router runs with a Judge/validator rubric replay prompts against the candidates; off-policy distill runs have the teacher answer each prompt.

teacher.description: On-policy distill runs: the teacher's scoring tokens at the teacher's price (included in estimated_tokens as student-price tokens, and in estimated_cost_usd).

version.description: Dataset version (default: the current one, pinned at plan time).

rubric.description: Judges, regexes and validators (default: the dataset's own rubric, such as a benchmark's answer check). Code scorers can't run during training.

limit.description: Evaluate the first N tasks at each checkpoint.

name.description: Name of this eval in the report (default: the dataset name).

teacher.description: CartridgeRecipe and DistillRecipe: the model to learn from. DistillRecipe also takes an artifact (name@version) with rollout off_policy.

eval_every.description: Optimizer steps between held-out evaluations; auto = every 25% of the run, at most every 20 steps; each eval step is also a checkpoint.

rubric.description: RouterRecipe: a score name on your records (scores[rubric]), or Judge/validator items: the server then replays each prompt against recipe.models and scores the answers in a labeling eval before training. RewardModelRecipe: a score name in [0, 1] on records ending in an assistant turn, trained pointwise next to the chosen/rejected pairs.

pricing.description: RouterRecipe: USD per request for each candidate; overrides metrics.cost_usd on your records.

fallback.description: RouterRecipe: the candidate that gets every request the router does not offload (default: the best-scoring candidate).

max_new_tokens.description: CartridgeRecipe: teacher answer length per prompt during distillation (default 256).

slot_token.description: CartridgeRecipe: a reserved token that marks where the cartridge goes (default: the first reserved token that tokenizes atomically).

evals.description: Extra evals on each checkpoint during training (the eval executor, billed like any eval). Results are in run.checkpoint_evals, the run's checkpoint_eval events and eval_report.checkpoint_evals.

loggers.description: Experiment trackers that receive the run's metrics. A tracker that fails is reported and dropped; it never fails the run.

token_counts.description: Token counts (total, trained and per span) are estimates (about 4 characters per token); the trainer tokenizes with the model's pinned tokenizer, and the run's metrics report the exact tokens.

label_eval_id.description: The labeling eval whose answers the run trains on: router runs with a Judge/validator rubric, and off-policy distill runs (the teacher's answers).

checkpoint_evals.description: recipe.evals, with the dataset version and rubric pinned.

RolloutSpec.description: DistillRecipe: on_policy (default) samples answers from the student and the trainer scores them with the teacher's top-k logits; off_policy has the teacher answer each prompt once through the inference endpoint and trains the student on those answers.

max_new_tokens.description: Length of each student answer; auto (default) sizes it from the assistant turns in your records (256 without any).

RouterParetoSummary.description: Router quality vs. cost on the held-out report fold, against the fallback model. Values are null when no report prompt was scored for every candidate.

name.description: Run name; its artifact is released as `name@version`.

dataset_id.description: Id of the dataset trained on.

dataset_name.description: Name of the dataset trained on.

dataset_version.description: The dataset version the run pinned when it was created.

max_cost_usd.description: Hard spend cap in USD (null: none). The run is never billed past it.

price_per_million_tokens.description: USD per million tokens processed, fixed when the run was created.

tokens_processed.description: Training tokens processed so far, over every attempt.

cost_usd.description: Cost of the tokens processed so far, in USD. It counts the whole step that crossed max_cost_usd; billing stops at the cap.

attempt.description: Attempts started so far (every start on a worker counts, including ones whose GPU was reclaimed).

max_attempts.description: The run fails once this many attempts end without a result (lost worker, worker error, OOM). Attempts whose GPU was reclaimed don't count toward it.

phase.description: What the run is doing now while it is queued or running.

phase_since.description: When the run entered its phase.

workers_online.description: While queued: workers of this kind holding a lease (all busy). Null otherwise.

autoscaling.description: While queued: true when workers scale from zero (KEDA), so a worker is starting. Null otherwise.

queue_position.description: While queued for a worker: about how many runs start before this one. Claims are fair across workspaces (the workspace with the fewest running runs goes next), so this counts other workspaces' runs too. Approximate; null otherwise.

queue_message.description: While queued for a worker: why it waits, ready to show: "Queued behind 3 runs", "Queued: workspace concurrency limit (8 running)" (the workspace runs as many as it may at once), or "Waiting for a GPU with ≥46 GB; online workers have 24 GB". Null when it is next in line, and once it is claimed.

min_gpu_memory_gb.description: GPU memory (GB) the run needs (its plan's min_gpu_memory_gb): only workers with at least this much claim it. Null when unknown.

checkpoint_evals.description: recipe.evals results, one per finished eval: a checkpoint (step) on a dataset.

artifact_id.description: The released artifact (`name@version`) once the run completes; null before.

error.description: Why the run failed or stopped; null otherwise.

finished_at.description: When the run reached a final status; null while it is queued or running.

warnings.description: Only on the response that created the run (POST /v1/runs): the plan's warnings, such as another queued or running run with the same name. They're also the run's first warning events.

RunEvent.description: One event of a run's lifecycle, discriminated by `type`. `completed` is always last.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page (every list endpoint).

tail_cursor.description: Cursor after the newest event returned so far; pass it back as `cursor` to poll for later events.

RunPhase.description: Where a run is in its lifecycle (on a Run: the latest phase; once the run is terminal, status is authoritative and phase is the last one reached). queued, waiting_for_compute (queued for longer than the server's threshold with no worker claiming it) and starting (a worker claimed it) come from the server; the worker reports the rest. training, evaluating and checkpointing repeat.

RunStatus.description: stopped_budget: the run reached its max_cost_usd (resume with a higher cap). stopped_balance: the workspace ran out of balance on Cloud (top up, then resume; the cap is unchanged). Both keep their checkpoints.

version.description: Dataset version to score (default: the current version).

Secret.description: A workspace secret's metadata. The value is never returned.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'; unique per workspace.

allowed_hosts.description: The hosts this secret may be sent to.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'; unique per workspace.

value.description: Write-only: stored encrypted and never returned by any endpoint.

allowed_hosts.description: Hosts (`host[:port]`, or URLs) this secret may be sent to: a source's host, huggingface.co for HF imports, a logger's host. Default: the public hosts of the supported providers (cloud.langfuse.com, us.cloud.langfuse.com, api.smith.langchain.com, eu.api.smith.langchain.com, api.braintrust.dev, us.posthog.com, eu.posthog.com, app.phoenix.arize.com, huggingface.co, api.wandb.ai). A secret for a self-hosted tool must name its host. Replacing a secret replaces its hosts.

Source.description: An observability provider synced into one dataset. A source feeds exactly one dataset; a dataset can have several sources. Deleting the dataset deletes its sources; removing a source keeps the dataset.

filters.description: The effective filters: validated, with single values as lists.

sample_rate.description: The share of traces synced (1: all).

records_today.description: New traces synced so far this UTC day (what max_records_per_day counts).

version_interval.description: Seconds between the dataset versions scheduled syncs commit (0: every sync).

pending_records.description: Records scheduled syncs fetched that wait for the next dataset version.

next_sync_at.description: When the schedule fires next (null without a schedule or while paused). After a failed sync the schedule backs off: twice its interval per consecutive failure, at most an hour.

status.description: `paused` after 10 consecutive failed syncs: the schedule stops firing. A manual sync, or setting a new value for the source's secret, resumes it.

paused_reason.description: Why the source is paused (null while active).

last_error.description: The error of the last failed sync (provider keys redacted); cleared by a successful sync.

consecutive_failures.description: Failed syncs since the last successful one.

pending_full.description: A full sync was requested while another sync ran; it is queued as soon as that one ends.

last_synced_at.description: When the last successful sync finished.

kind.description: One of langfuse, langsmith, braintrust, posthog, phoenix, gradiated; anything else is 422 source_provider_unsupported.

host.description: The provider's API host (https). Optional for providers with one public host; not used by 'gradiated'.

secret.description: Name of the workspace secret holding the provider key. Not used by 'gradiated'.

project.description: The provider project to read. Required for braintrust (project id or name) and posthog (numeric project id); optional elsewhere (LangSmith project, Phoenix project).

filters.description: Which traces to sync; a trace must match every key. Values are a string or a list (any of which matches) unless noted: `tags` (list: every tag), `environment`, `model`, `version`, `release`, `name` (trace name or route), `user_id`, `session_id`, `metadata` (`{key: value}`, each equal), `from`/`to` (ISO 8601: the trace started in [from, to)), `has_feedback` (true: a score or a correction) and `min_score` (a number every score must reach, or `{name: number}`). Score filters are judged on the merged dataset, so feedback that arrives later still counts. LangSmith also takes `filter` (a LangSmith filter expression, AND-ed); gradiated takes `models`, `tasks` and `versions`. Any other key is 422 source_filter_unsupported. The response holds the effective filters (single values as lists).

SourceSync.description: The most recent sync, running or finished.

full.description: Rebuild the dataset from the provider as a new version (ignores the stored watermark).

min_gpu_memory_gb.description: GPU memory (GB) training this base needs at the recipe defaults, measured on an H100 80 GB. v0 trains on one GPU, and runs.plan refuses (422 model_exceeds_gpu_memory) a run that needs more than 80 GB. Null when unknown.

UpdateSourceRequest.description: Fields left out keep their value. Changes apply from the next sync; traces already synced stay (a full sync rebuilds the dataset with the new settings).

filters.description: Replaces the source's filters ({} clears them). Which traces to sync; a trace must match every key. Values are a string or a list (any of which matches) unless noted: `tags` (list: every tag), `environment`, `model`, `version`, `release`, `name` (trace name or route), `user_id`, `session_id`, `metadata` (`{key: value}`, each equal), `from`/`to` (ISO 8601: the trace started in [from, to)), `has_feedback` (true: a score or a correction) and `min_score` (a number every score must reach, or `{name: number}`). Score filters are judged on the merged dataset, so feedback that arrives later still counts. LangSmith also takes `filter` (a LangSmith filter expression, AND-ed); gradiated takes `models`, `tasks` and `versions`. Any other key is 422 source_filter_unsupported. The response holds the effective filters (single values as lists).

schedule.description: Five-field cron in UTC (`*/15 * * * *`); minute resolution, so it fires at most once a minute (a seconds field is rejected). Leave it out to sync only on request.

sample_rate.description: The share of traces to sync, chosen by a hash of the trace id: re-syncs keep the same sample, and a trace's feedback follows it. Default 1.

max_records_per_sync.description: At most this many new traces per sync; the rest are not synced (the sync's drop reasons count them). Feedback on traces already synced always lands. Null: no cap.

max_records_per_day.description: At most this many new traces per UTC day; the rest are not synced (the sync's drop reasons count them). Feedback on traces already synced always lands. Null: no cap.

version_interval.description: Seconds between the dataset versions scheduled syncs commit (default 900). A scheduled sync may fetch every minute; its parts wait, staged, until the interval has passed or enough records are waiting, so a busy source doesn't add a version a minute. 0: every sync commits. Manual and full syncs always commit.

upload_id.description: The file's sha256: uploads are content-addressed, so re-uploading the same bytes is harmless.

url.description: Presigned S3 PUT URL; send exactly `headers` (they bind the length and sha256).

key.description: The group: a UTC day or week start (YYYY-MM-DD), a month (YYYY-MM), a model, a recipe or a kind. Null for usage with no recipe (plain evals, scoring).

UsageKind.description: What the tokens paid for: `training` (a run's attempts), `eval` (evals, including a run's checkpoint evals), `scoring` (dataset.score), `labeling` (a router run's labeling eval) or `teacher` (an off-policy distill run's teacher answers).

ref_id.description: The run (kind `training`) or eval this usage belongs to.

run_id.description: The run the usage was billed for: the run itself, or the run whose labeling, teacher or checkpoint eval it is.

tokens_from.description: The attempt's tokens this row starts after (usage is billed in increments while an attempt runs).

billed_by.description: Who bills this usage: `grad` (training, and evals on a self-hosted server) or `gateway` (on Gradiated Cloud, eval model and judge tokens are billed once by the inference gateway; shown here, not charged twice).

by_kind.description: One entry per kind with usage, costliest first.

top_runs.description: The costliest runs' training in the period (up to 5).

top_evals.description: The costliest evals, scoring, labeling and teacher jobs in the period (up to 5).

groups.description: With group_by: one entry per group with usage, oldest first for time groups and costliest first otherwise.

seq.description: Position in the run's event sequence (the SSE event id; pass it as Last-Event-ID or `cursor` to resume). `completed` repeats the last stored seq.
